title: Embracing Diversity: Interpretable Zero-shot classification beyond one vector per class

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot image classification accuracy across different geographic regions and countries using the DollarStreet and GeoDE datasets.
Measuring zero-shot image classification accuracy across different household income levels using the DollarStreet dataset.

Comparing classification accuracy disparities between typical and atypical object states (e.g., whole vs. peeled pear) and hierarchical subclasses (e.g., typical fox vs. Arctic fox) using datasets like MIT States and Breeds.
